notes.title: Massive Update - 40 000 New Levels! And -80% off this week!
notes.notes:
The BADLAND Level World is now available also from the Steam version. Browse, play and rate over 40 000 (and counting) player made levels in conveniently ranked categories. The update adds also a constantly updating new day with 18 levels + a new level added every one to two weeks.

New features:
- LEVEL WORLD added with 40 000+ player made levels
- Find good levels easily from categories such as ‘Most played’, ’Top rated’, “Frogmind’s Choice”, etc.
- New day added! Welcome to the 'Eternal Day' with 18 levels and a new level added every one to two weeks
- Added new leaderboards for Eternal Day and Level World

Fixes:
- Multiple controllers could in some cases change the controlled player
- The analog sticks of all controllers should now work
- Keyboard binding fixes
- Multiple smaller bug fixes based on your feedback

Last spring our tablet based level editor was opened to the players of the iPad version of BADLAND. And some month later for Google Play. The players have been making new levels since then and some of these are really rad, very ambitious for quality, creativity and for trying new things. 

The editor is based on multitouch editing and is thus difficult to add to the PC version without a major user interface overhaul. But all levels are now available from the Steam version. Should you want to make some levels, you need to use the App Store or Google Play version of BADLAND. All new levels will be instantly available also from the Steam version.

The Level World comes with single player, multiplayer and co-op levels. So get playing the 40 000+ new levels! There's plenty of new things to do and a lot more variety ranging from White BADLAND to driving cars, tanks, flying laser gunning vehicles, levels mimicking other indie games and more! 

We’ll keep checking the forums after the update goes live. So let us know if you bump into any issues that need fixing. 

Thanks for your awesome support!
